effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated, while you control another Aquamarine monster (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 WATER Aqua monster from your GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect now accepts either player's negatable activation while another face-up Aquamarine is controlled. Its cost banishes one WATER Aqua from the GY, then it negates the activation and destroys the related activating card.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses EVENT_CHAINING, Duel.IsChainNegatable, a cost, Duel.NegateActivation, and destruction of the activated card.
